description: Updates an existing item (question or other) via batchUpdate updateItem. The item is addressed by its 0-based index — call get_form first to see current positions and the item's current shape. item is a raw Forms API Item object with the new values; update_mask names the fields to replace, e.g. "title" or "title,questionItem.question.required". Only masked fields change; masking a field the item object leaves unset clears it.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

index.description: 0-based position of the item to update (from get_form).

item.description: The Forms API Item object with the new values, e.g. {"title":"New title","questionItem":{"question":{"required":true}}}.

update_mask.description: Comma-separated field paths to replace, e.g. "title,questionItem.question.required".

name: update_question
title: Update an item
